description: Returns the phone numbers on the user's ExpressNumber account that are live or still being set up. Each one has an id, the number in E.164 form, a label, the area code, the mode (forwarding, blocked or texts_only) and the status. Use it first, to get the number ids that get_latest_messages takes, or to see which numbers the user has. It changes nothing.
name: list_numbers
title: List my numbers
